pen_mm.description: Line weight in millimetres at print scale. Limited to the pen series so drawings plot predictably and map onto DXF lineweights.

classification.description: Classification used by the detail review overlays. All fields optional. On a material it is the default; the same object under `tags` on an assembly layer or detail region overrides it for that use.

package.description: Subcontractor package that supplies and fixes the item.

barrier.description: Which barrier functions the item performs. A layer may perform more than one.

fire_role.description: Fire strategy role. Reaction class and rating stay in properties.fire.

sequence.description: Construction sequence: 1 is installed first. On a material it is a default step; on a layer or region `tags` it sets the step for that use. Only the order matters, not the size of the gaps.

shearing_layer.description: Brand's shearing layer: how fast the item changes over a building's life. Site, structure, skin, services, space plan (interior finishes and partitions) or stuff (furniture and fittings).

sfb.description: CI/SfB element code in brackets, for example (21) external walls, (27) roofs, (43) floor finishes. The SfB overlay groups by the first digit: (1) ground and substructure, (2) structure and primary elements, (3) secondary elements, (4) finishes, (5) and (6) services, (7) fittings, (9) external elements.

height_limit_m.description: Wall profiles: the height of the band layers above the path, in metres. Absent or 0 gives 2.7. A region layer repeating up the profile (repeat_y_m) stops at the last whole row below it.

lineweights.description: Pen weight for each drawing role, in millimetres at print scale. Omitted roles use the defaults: cut 0.35, seen 0.18, hatch 0.09, annotation 0.09. When cut is omitted, drawings may use a weight by layer function (structure 0.5, finish 0.35, insulation 0.25, service 0.25, membrane 0.18).

thickness.description: Layer thickness in metres. A membrane keeps its nominal thickness (for example 0.0005 for a 0.5 mm DPC); it is never zero.

function.description: What the layer does. A 'membrane' layer (DPC, vapour control layer, breather membrane, tape), or a layer whose material has the category 'membrane', is drawn on top: as a heavy line in 2D and with priority over coplanar faces in 3D.

outline_mm.description: Overrides the profile's cut weight for this layer's outline. On a membrane layer it is the weight of the membrane line (default 0.5).

depth_m.description: Region layers: the length of one unit along the run (a brick's 215 mm). Used with repeat_x_m.

repeat_x_m.description: Region layers: pitch of the units along the run, from start to start. At least depth_m; the gap is the joint. Used with depth_m.

repeat_y_m.description: Region layers: pitch of rows of the unit up the profile (profile y), such as brick courses or battens.

offset_x_m.description: Region layers: shift along the run of every second row, for a bond. Half of repeat_x_m gives a half-bond.

offset_y_m.description: Region layers: shift up of the first row.
